library.title: Library
library.hint: Drag equipment onto the canvas (or double-click it). Then drag a link from an output port, on the right of a block, to an input port, on the left.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select equipment or a link to see its properties.
inspector.name: Name
inspector.userSource: custom model, values entered by the user.
inspector.saveTemplateHint: Adds this block to "My models" to reuse it in other projects

direction.msg: Two outputs or two inputs connected.
direction.fix: Connect an output to an input.

signal-mismatch.fix: Check the port or add a converter.

level-mic-to-line.msg: Mic level into a line input (+4 dBu).
level-mic-to-line.fix: Use a preamp or a mic input.

level-line-to-mic.msg: Line level into a mic input: risk of clipping.
level-line-to-mic.fix: Use a line input or a pad.

level-speaker-to-line.msg: Amplified speaker output into a low-level input: risk of damage.
level-speaker-to-line.fix: Connect the speaker output to a passive speaker.

level-line-to-speaker.msg: Unamplified signal into a passive speaker.
level-line-to-speaker.fix: Add an amplifier or use a powered speaker.

adapter-needed.fix: Plan an adapter or a dedicated cable.

input-busy.msg: Several sources on the same input.
input-busy.fix: Use another input or a mixer.

output-busy.msg: This digital or network output feeds several destinations.
output-busy.fix: Add a distribution amp, a switch or a router.

output-split.msg: Analog output shared between several inputs.
output-split.fix: Check impedance or use a splitter.

phantom-missing.msg: Condenser mic on an input without 48 V phantom power.
phantom-missing.fix: Use a mic input with phantom power, or an external phantom supply.

phantom-unknown.msg: Condenser mic: check that the input provides 48 V phantom.
phantom-unknown.fix: Enable 48 V on the input, or set the port's phantom capability.

cable-mismatch.msg: The cable "{{cable}}" does not connect {{from}} to {{to}}.
cable-mismatch.fix: Choose a compatible cable in the link inspector.

pair-busy.msg: Pair {{pair}} of multicore {{cable}} is already used by another link.
pair-busy.fix: Choose a free pair in the link inspector.

pair-range.msg: Pair {{pair}} does not exist: multicore {{cable}} has {{pairs}} pairs.
pair-range.fix: Choose a pair between 1 and the pair count, or enlarge the multicore.

pair-missing.msg: Link assigned to multicore {{cable}} without a pair number.
pair-missing.fix: Choose the pair used in the link inspector.

channels-over.msg: {{n}} channels carried for a declared capacity of {{max}}.
channels-over.fix: Reduce the number of flows, or check the port capacity.

dock.noIssues: No issues: all links are compatible.
dock.missingPower: {{n}} item(s) without declared power: minimum total.
dock.noMulticore: No multicore yet. Create one, then assign links to its pairs from the inspector.

merge.title: Merge another version
merge.hint: Version to merge: "{{name}}". Here is what the merge will change in the open project.
merge.nothingAdded: Nothing new in the other version.
merge.renumbered_one: {{count}} added link gets a new cable number (duplicate).
merge.renumbered_other: {{count}} added links get a new cable number (duplicates).
merge.noConflict: No element changed on both sides.
merge.limit: Limit: a deletion made in the other version is not carried over (the element stays). The merge can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.intro: The assistant helps you build and check your diagram. It only places equipment from the library and has its proposals checked by the rules engine. It stays off until you set it up: local AI on your computer, or your own AI account.
ai.hello: Ask a question or describe the system you need. Proposed additions are shown as a preview: nothing changes until you accept.
ai.desktopOnly: The assistant works in the desktop app: it sends the requests and keeps the key in the system keychain.
ai.placeholder: Your question (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.sentTo: Your messages and the relevant parts of the diagram are sent to {{provider}}.
ai.proposalIssues_one: {{count}} rules engine warning on the proposed links
ai.proposalIssues_other: {{count}} rules engine warnings on the proposed links
ai.applyHint: Applying is a single step: Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.proposalStale: The diagram changed since the proposal: it was not applied. Ask the assistant again.

suggest.review: Check my diagram and tell me what is missing
suggest.concert: Draft a diagram for a small concert: 4 mics, a console, two powered speakers
suggest.di: Why use a DI box on a keyboard?

error.auth: Key rejected by the provider: check it or create a new one.
error.billing: API billing not enabled or credit exhausted with the provider.
error.rate: Too many requests: try again in a moment.
error.server: The provider returned an error: try again later.
error.network: Cannot connect (network, local server stopped, or desktop app required).
error.steps: The assistant did not conclude after several steps: rephrase or split your request.

setup.title: AI assistant: setup
setup.chooseHint: Two options, same assistant. You can switch at any time.
setup.localDesc: Free, offline, no data leaves the computer. Decent quality, limited by the model size. Needs a fairly recent computer.
setup.accountDesc: Best quality (large models). Billed per use by your provider, with your own API key. Internet required.
setup.serverHint: Pick the software that runs the model on your computer, then detect it. It must be running with at least one model installed (able to call functions).
setup.downloadLater: Downloading a model from AV Diagram comes in a later version. Meanwhile, use Ollama or LM Studio, or llama-server with a .gguf model you downloaded.
setup.noModel: Connected, but no model is installed on this server.
setup.localModelHint: Prefer a multilingual model that can call functions (tools).
setup.testHint: Last step: a simple question to check that the model answers.
setup.testQuestion: What is the nominal level of a professional balanced audio line?
setup.providerHint: Pick the provider of your AI account.
setup.subscriptionWarn: A chat subscription (Claude Pro or Max, ChatGPT Plus, Gemini) does not include API access. You need an API key, billed separately, per use.
setup.createHint: Open the {{provider}} console, sign in, enable API billing, then create a key and copy it.
setup.geminiNote: Gemini offers a limited free tier. Check its terms, in particular how your data may be used.
setup.keyHint: The key is stored in the system's secure keychain, never in a file. AV Diagram never shows it again.
setup.keyPresent: A key is stored for this provider.
setup.keyOptional: Optional key, for a server that does not require one.

shape.spaces: The key contains spaces: check the copy and paste.
shape.prefix: A key from this provider normally starts with "{{prefix}}". Check the copy and paste.

setup.connectHint: A small request (model list) checks the key, billing and access to the service.
setup.costHint: Each question is billed by the provider according to its length and the length of the reply. See the rates on its console.
setup.dataHint: Sent to {{provider}}: your messages, a summary of the diagram and the device sheets the assistant reads. Processing may take place outside the European Union.
setup.consent: I agree to send this data to {{provider}}.
setup.managedHint: Pick the llama-server program (llama.cpp archive for your system) and a .gguf model. AV Diagram starts the server on your computer (127.0.0.1) when you ask a question, and stops it on exit.
setup.launching: Starting llama-server and loading the model (up to 3 min)…
